checks.detail: | rustls / tokio-rustls | 精确0.23.46 / 0.26.6，[来源与设计](research/secure-transport-design.md) | rustls Apache-2.0 OR ISC OR MIT；tokio-rustls MIT OR Apache-2.0。官方crate checksum已核，显式ring/std、关闭默认features；新transport基础库只启TLS1.3，不代表USB路径已接入TLS |

| ring / rustls-webpki / rustls-pki-types | 实际解析0.17.14 / 0.103.16 / 1.15.1 | Cargo元数据分别为Apache-2.0 AND ISC、ISC、MIT OR Apache-2.0；ring完整`LICENSE`另列BoringSSL及历史来源条款，须按各crate完整许可分发。不能把密码库和底层unsafe表述为自有MIT实现或FIPS认证 |

findings.statement: Three new third-party rows accurately state pinned versions, Cargo SPDX metadata, ring mixed-source license boundary and dev-only rcgen scope.
ring is not pure Rust: C/assembly, build-time cc and platform-specific crypto paths remain transitive dependencies. No FIPS claim or arbitrary target compatibility is established.
ring default alloc/dev_urandom_fallback features are enabled transitively. Current Rustls/Tokio defaults are disabled; this is not a claim that all transitive defaults are disabled.

ring SystemRandom delegates to OS getrandom, and its first fill may synchronously block. Tokio five-second timeout is an asynchronous deadline, not preemption of synchronous crypto/RNG work inside a poll.

set_buffer_limit(65536) bounds the two write-direction Rustls buffers separately. It is not a 64KiB total-connection RSS cap, does not cap all peer-certificate/crypto allocations, and does not replace application backpressure/deadlines.
Rustls fixed handshake reassembly MAX_HANDSHAKE_SIZE=0xffff is source evidence. No load/fuzz/RSS or timing measurement was executed by this reviewer.

Production normal/build metadata graph excludes rcgen/time/yasna/x509-parser. Metadata/lock include all-target and optional edges; recorded host feature tree is narrower and excludes x509-parser. Neither lock presence nor metadata superset alone proves a package was compiled into a production artifact.

Source versions have MSRV metadata (ring1.66, rustls/tokio1.71, pki1.60, zeroize1.85, rcgen/time1.88); workspace1.97 exceeds them. Native GNU/musl x86_64/aarch64 builds still need actual per-target CI. This review is not a new platform PASS.

No binary package is being distributed by this review. Full source license notices (including ring once_cell/BoringSSL portions) remain relevant to a later redistribution audit; metadata SPDX is not a substitute for per-file notices.
